raw:
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "查询所有有效订单的总销售金额。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "计算 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的所有记录的 paid_amount 总和。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:sum:paid_amount:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT SUM(paid_amount) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有在售商品的品牌和所属类目。",
      "category": "filtering",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "从 products 表中筛选 is_active = 1 的商品，返回其 brand 和 category 字段。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "filtering:products:is_active:product_name_category",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT brand, category FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "统计所有有效订单对应的独立付费用户数。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "统计 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的记录所关联的 user_id 去重数量。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count_distinct:user_id:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS paying_users FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按城市汇总有效订单的销售金额，并降序排列。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "联结 orders 与 users 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单按 users.city 分组，求 paid_amount 总和，并按该总和降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:city:sales_amount:orders_users:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "计算所有有效订单中每件商品的平均购买数量。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "联结 orders 与 order_items 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单对应的商品行，计算 quantity 的平均值。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:avg:quantity:order_items:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT AVG(oi.quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按品牌汇总有效订单的商品销售金额，并降序排列。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "联结 orders、order_items 和 products 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的订单对应商品行，按 products.brand 分组求 item_amount 总和，并按该总和降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:brand:sales_amount:orders_items_products:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计各商品类目在有效订单中的销售金额及对应已批准退款金额。",
      "category": "join",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "联结 orders、order_items、products 和 refunds 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 且 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，按 products.category 分组，分别计算 item_amount 总和与 refund_amount 总和。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "join:category:sales_refund:orders_items_products_refunds:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.category;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "计算手机数码类目的产品退款率。",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "计算手机数码类目下，已批准退款金额总和除以该类目有效订单商品销售金额总和（四舍五入保留4位小数）。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "refund:rate:category:手机数码:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "统计已批准退款中各类退款原因的出现次数。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "从 refunds 表中筛选 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，按 refund_reason 分组计数。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count:refund_reason:refunds:approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "查询2026年各月有效订单的销售金额趋势。",
      "category": "time",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "从 orders 表中筛选 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的记录，按 order_date 的年份和月份分组，计算 paid_amount 总和，并按年月升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "time:monthly:orders_sales:2026:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS year, MONTH(order_date) AS month, SUM(paid_amount) AS monthly_sales FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND YEAR(order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY YEAR(order_date), MONTH(order_date) ORDER BY year, month;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
